purpose: Reproducible MVP2 digital-twin toolchain target; versions are pinned independently from availability.
notes: The CI core pins Python 3.12 and uv and does not require optional solver binaries.
The WSL headless environment uses micromamba for CadQuery and openEMS Python bindings; it stays separate from the project .venv.
The Zephyr workspace baseline is 4.2.1 with SDK 0.16.8 and west 1.5.0.
The openEMS/CSXCAD pair is pinned to the upstream 0.37.0-rc3/0.7.0-rc3 submodule set.
All optional tools must be reported unavailable or version-mismatched explicitly; they are never silently replaced.
